I saw that we already has the CG sets for the other two works in the Insight Sexual Duty girl Locker series, but this particular one was missing. So I went ahead and uploaded it myself. Pics from insight.jp official.

I’m seriously addicted to stuff where a girl gets tightly bound / shibari’d and locked inside a classroom locker. Completely immobilized, no way to resist or run, just left there for anyone to come by and use her however they want. Public-use fuck toy vibes. Forced to cum over and over until she’s shaking, drooling, mind-breaking level of overstimulation… and still nowhere to escape. Author draw these type of fetish include: "eto", "murakami suigun", "as109"...
Goddamn, it’s so fucking hot.

I once had an Insight figure with pierced nipples.
Unfortunately, the quality was really shitty. From what I know, this company seems way more focused on using gorgeous 3D renders to bait preorders, but then the actual product just gets slapped together with low-res 3D printing to cut corners. Especially when preorder numbers are too low to cover mold costs.
It looks like they have three tiers of models:
The top tier is basically naked versions of others all-ages figures, reusing existing molds for the body.
The mid tier is for originals with decent preorder volume, using resin (light-cured) printing.
The absolute worst is for super low-preorder originals, just slapped together with crappy low-precision 3D prints to barely fulfill orders.
I really hope Insight starts taking figure quality seriously and stops scamming people.
